headline: energyRe Sells 317 MW Solar Portfolio to Enel Green Power North America
summary: energyRe agreed to sell a 317 MWdc solar project portfolio in South Carolina to Enel Green Power North America. energyRe will manage construction until the deal closes in Q1 2027.
why: energyRe is an American renewable energy developer focused on utility-scale solar, wind, and storage infrastructure projects.
